source_name: ZRSZ (Zavod RS za zaposlovanje) — public employment service job listings
why_relevant: State employment service; its EURES page also enumerates the Slovenian private job-portal landscape (MojeDelo, Kariera, Competo, Deloglasnik, Zaposlitev.info, Rekruter…), which is the pointer value. Some vacancies are legally required to be reported here.

source_name: SPOT (spot.gov.si) – 'Dovoljenje za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave zavarovalnice' and related permit descriptions
why_relevant: The state business portal enumerates, per activity, every permit a financial-sector actor needs and which authority issues it. It is an excellent pointer for completing the actor/permit map (which body approves which board role — BS, ATVP or AZN) and for discovering permit types not visible from the regulators' own navigation.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije – Members / Članice directory
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the Slovenian banking employer population: 13 banks and savings banks plus ~15 leasing companies. This is the seed list for every downstream employer-level jobs/leadership crawl in SI.

source_name: Optius Karierna svetovalnica - agency-work explainer (pointer to agency landscape)
why_relevant: Enumerates the larger SI employment agencies - Trenkwalder, Manpower, Kariera, ProHuman, Agado, FMG, Korotaj, Dekra, Trgotur, Atama, Personal Center - giving a ready-made actor list of intermediaries to monitor for bank and payments mandates.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of Slovenian associations (ZBS, ZNS, ZIT, SZZ, Blockchain Alliance Europe)
why_relevant: Associations announce board elections, committee chairs and their own secretariat vacancies here first; the 'People' tab is the only public view of secretariat headcount and role mix. Highest-velocity channel in this cell.

source_name: ATVP - Seznam javnih druzb (list of public companies)
why_relevant: Enumerates Slovenian issuers subject to disclosure obligations, which includes listed banks. Public-company status is what forces timely disclosure of management and supervisory board appointments, so this list identifies exactly which SI banking employers will produce dated, regulated leadership announcements.

source_name: BetterCareer.si — Slovenian IT-company employer directory
why_relevant: A curated directory of Slovenian IT companies with employer profiles; useful as a pointer to expand the cell's actor map beyond the seeded vendor names (smaller SI integrators and fintech dev shops that also sell into banks).

source_name: University of Ljubljana FSD - list of SI job-search websites (portal directory)
why_relevant: An academic career-service directory enumerating SI employment portals (Zaposlitev.net, Zaposlim.se, Moje Delo, Moja Zaposlitev, Kariera and others). Useful as a snowball pointer for portals not surfaced by search engines, though the document is dated and needs liveness re-checking for each listed site.

source_name: AJPES / Bizi.si business-register profiles of associations (GIZ, zbornice)
why_relevant: Register-derived profiles of the associations themselves — registered legal representatives, address, employee counts and filing history. Provides an independent, legally-grounded check on who formally represents an association and how big its secretariat is, when the association's own site is silent.

source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT), sections & membership
why_relevant: The GZS branch association closest to payments/fintech vendors: its membership and section pages point to the Slovenian ICT firms that supply banks, and its section leadership changes are appointment events. Nearest available substitute for a dedicated GZS financial-services fintech section.

source_name: Banka Sparkasse d.d. – Zaposlovanje (Erste Group careers portal)
why_relevant: Slovenian arm of Erste/Steiermärkische. Careers page states applications run EXCLUSIVELY through the Erste Group careers portal, so the group ATS is the authoritative feed and the SI-only page is a pointer. Erste's portal exposes a per-entity category (bankasparkasse) that can be polled for SI roles.

source_name: Drustvo Mali delnicarji Slovenije (MDS) - SEOnet aggregation by bank
why_relevant: Minority-shareholder association that aggregates SEOnet notices and maintains per-bank taxonomy pages (NLB, Gorenjska banka, Addiko, SKB, BKS Bank, Sberbank, DBS, Intesa Sanpaolo, Delavska hranilnica, Primorska hranilnica, Hranilnica LON, SID banka, UniCredit). An effective index for finding which banks have historically issued disclosures and for snowballing to smaller institutions this cell must still cover.

source_name: PISRS / zakonodaja.com – ZBan-2/ZBan-3, ZBS-1, ZZavar-1, ZPlaSSIED statutory basis for board authorisations
why_relevant: Defines exactly which appointments must be approved and published, and by whom — e.g. ZBan-2 art. 45 duties of board members, the sub-chapters on 'Uprava banke', ZBan-1 art. 65 'Dovoljenje za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave banke', ZBS-1 for the Bank of Slovenia's own governance. Without this the collection pipeline cannot tell a legally mandated disclosure from an optional one, nor anticipate where a new publication duty will appear.

source_name: Primorska hranilnica Vipava – Zaposlujemo / Aktualna delovna mesta
why_relevant: Small regional savings bank; its careers page explicitly states vacancies are published regularly on Mojedelo.com, with an on-site open-application route. Confirms the MojeDelo-as-de-facto-ATS pattern for the savings-bank tier and gives a concrete company profile to snowball.

source_name: startup.si — Slovenian startup/scaleup map (Paywiser entry)
why_relevant: State-backed startup map that enumerates Slovenian fintech/payments companies with founder and contact data — a snowball source for actors below the licensing radar that bank-focused searches never surface.

entity_name: BKS Bank AG, bancna podruznica Slovenija
source_name: BKS Bank AG, bancna podruznica Slovenija – Kariera
why_relevant: Austrian bank's Slovenian branch. Career section explicitly routes applications through the MojeDelo portal (kariera@bksbank.si as contact) — a documented example of the 'bank uses MojeDelo instead of an ATS' pattern this cell must cover. Small headcount means each vacancy is proportionally more informative.

source_name: CEE Chamber - Top recruitment agencies in Ljubljana (directory article)
why_relevant: Pointer article enumerating SI recruitment/search agencies with sector specialisms - the cheapest way to expand the actor map beyond the four firms named in the brief.

source_name: Glasford International - Slovenia office page
why_relevant: Network parent page confirming Competo as the SI member; useful for cross-border mandate signals and for snowballing to other Adria offices covering SI banking clients.

source_name: Kadrovske agencije v Sloveniji (nasvetizavas.si overview)
why_relevant: Slovenian-language pointer listing local HR agencies and their terminology - a glossary and actor-map source in the local language rather than an English directory.

entity_name: Kompass Slovenia / iTIS Siol business directories
source_name: Kompass Slovenia / iTIS Siol business directories
why_relevant: Directory listings give address, activity classification and sometimes contact-person names for SI vendor entities (confirmed Payten d.o.o. entries on both si.kompass.com and itis.siol.net). Cheap way to enumerate lesser-known integrators by SKD activity code before profiling them.

source_name: Open Banking Tracker - Slovenia
why_relevant: Not a people-move source, but an English-language structured index of Slovenian banks and licensed TPPs/PSPs — the actor list against which appointment searches in this cell should be run.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija (digitalna.si) – Delovne skupine
why_relevant: Lists the coalition's working groups and the member organisations staffing them (blockchain WG brings together Blockchain Think Tank Slovenia, Blockchain Alliance, Bitcoin Society, Slovenian Blockchain Association) — a compact map of SI digital-finance interest groups and their nominated representatives.

entity_name: University career-office and alumni vacancy relays
source_name: University career-office and alumni vacancy relays (FMF UL, Karierni center EF, Alumni EF, Karierni sejem)
why_relevant: Slovenian banks and Bankart route graduate/junior technical vacancies through university career offices (Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, Faculty of Economics) and career fairs. These relays capture entry-level and internship hiring — the earliest signal of a team being stood up — that is often absent from corporate career pages, and frequently name the concrete team and technology.
